comments: '1h3' (string 2, twice) and '0h2' (string 3) are written as tight groups; the first digit lines up with the note below it and the target digit sits on the next grid slot, so each target is its own event. Wavy vertical line before the last chord is an arpeggio sign, not a barline. Lower-case x on string 6 = muted. Chord names ignored.
